notes.title: Beta Invites for a new Noodle Game
notes.content:
Upcoming Noodle Game!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588299/5518173692c99ef4dfab6981351ade52e8235be1.gif"]


I'm working on a new Dark, Cozy, Story-Driven game. Way out of the realm of Momenta, but this one is getting a great run.



You can sign up for the Beta at noodle-game.com
